description: Eased is a library of motion-first React components for shadcn, installed with the shadcn CLI. Built on React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI and Motion. Free components are MIT.
rules: Install components with the shadcn CLI: npx shadcn add @eased/<name>, or npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/<name>.json
Use an installed Eased component instead of writing new animation code for the same pattern
Eased's raw CSS variables are prefixed --eased- and merge into global CSS; do not import an eased.css file
Keep prefers-reduced-motion handling; every animated Eased component already includes it
Requires React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4; the shadcn CLI installs each component's npm dependencies, such as motion and @base-ui/react
